decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries in order to enable the Arclight Phoenix to be brought back from the graveyard. By utilizing cards that can draw additional cards, such as Treasure Cruise and Sleight of Hand, the deck aims to cast multiple spells in a turn to bring Arclight Phoenix back to the battlefield multiple times. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse for removal, as well as counterspells like Spell Pierce to protect its key creatures and spells.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on utilizing creatures with powerful abilities and synergies to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The deck includes cards like Craterhoof Behemoth and Elspeth, Storm Slayer to close out games efficiently. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility and resilience to the deck. The goal is to establish a strong board presence early on and continue applying pressure throughout the game with a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive red creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With a low mana curve and efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Sunspine Lynx, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage provide additional direct damage removal, while cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage boost the power of the creatures. The inclusion of lands like Ramunap Ruins and Mutavault ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around fast, aggressive plays to secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to swarm the board with small, aggressive creatures known as weenies, specifically white ones. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Warden of the Inner Sky to pump up your creatures, as well as cards like Portable Hole to remove any threats from your opponent's side of the board, you can overwhelm your opponent quickly. The inclusion of Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben provides additional value and disruption to secure victory in fast-paced matches.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively play Arclight Phoenix as quickly as possible by utilizing cheap spells and card draw. The deck includes a variety of low-cost spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Treasure Cruise and Opt to refill your hand and keep the pressure on your opponent. The inclusion of Artist's Talent and Picklock Prankster provides additional value and flexibility in getting the Phoenix back on the battlefield.

The main concept of this deck is to play a control strategy, utilizing Mono Black cards to disrupt the opponent's game plan and gain advantage. The deck focuses on removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats, while also using disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to dominate the late game. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out wins through card advantage and efficiency.

This deck focuses on using a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the opponent's board and hand. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent and close out the game. The deck's game plan revolves around resource management, disruption, and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats while maintaining control of the game tempo. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Castle Locthwain and Liliana of the Veil for card advantage and versatility in gameplay.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to deal damage as quickly as possible, using cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Burst Lightning, and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to take down the opponent's life total. The deck also includes cards like Monstrous Rage and Reckless Rage to pump up its creatures and clear the way for more damage. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, this deck is designed to apply pressure right from the start and maintain that pressure until the opponent is defeated.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures and spells in the color white. The deck focuses on playing multiple small creatures and utilizing abilities such as Anthems to boost their power and toughness. The inclusion of cards like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale helps to provide additional creature support, while cards like Ossification and Portable Hole offer removal options. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive strategy, allowing for consistent plays and powerful synergies.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to aggressively play creatures and boost their power with pump spells like "Sheltered by Ghosts" and removal spells like "Burst Lightning" and "Fiery Temper." Utilizing creatures like "Seasoned Hallowblade" and "Marauding Mako" to quickly deal damage and pressure the opponent. The inclusion of "Fear of Missing Out" provides additional reach and card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient creature-based strategy, utilizing the Boros color combination to maximize aggression and versatility.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The emphasis is on dealing damage swiftly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Burst Lightning, Kumano Faces Kakkazan, and Lightning Strike to take down opposing creatures and deal damage directly to the opponent. The creatures in the deck are designed to hit hard and fast, with cards like Manifold Mouse and Emberheart Challenger providing additional pressure. Overall, this deck aims to win the game by applying constant pressure and ending the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects like Mayhem Devil and Scavenger's Talent, creating value and dealing incremental damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute to steal or sacrifice opponent's creatures for additional advantage. With a mix of efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and strong creatures like Ygra, Eater of All, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control throughout the game. The mana base is designed to support a consistent and aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on using artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells. The inclusion of cards like Spyglass Siren and Memory Guardian also allows for disruption and protection against opposing strategies. This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard, while also utilizing cheap cantrips and removal spells to maintain aggression. The inclusion of Treasure Cruise helps to refill the hand after casting multiple spells in a turn. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Spell Pierce and Lightning Axe for additional disruption and flexibility.
